title: Extreme hazards
coreMove: When signal is thin, stop pretending to know and build margin for the hazard instead.
sourcePressure: Some severe hazards offer thin predictive signal; when clean prediction is weak, preparation, margin, and humility matter more than overconfident forecasting.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning rare hazards into panic or catastrophic statistics.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact for this chapter; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.
